definitions.short: a twin (in plural only), literally or figuratively
definitions.full: H8380. taom [ תּוֺאָם (Kö ii. 1. 69 תְּאֹם )] noun masculine twin (Late Hebrew id. ; compare Phoenician proper name, masculine תאם , Greek Θωμᾶς = δίδυμος John 20:24 ); — plural absolute of two boys תּוֺמִם Gen 25:24 (Ges § 23f .) תְּאוֺמִים 38:27 (both J); of animals, construct צְבִיָּה תְּאוֺמֵי Cant 4:5, צ ׳תָּאֳמֵי Cant 7:4.
